title: Book 1 — Clio, Chapter 25
paragraphs: Alyattes the Lydian, after waging war against the Milesians as described, died, having reigned fifty-seven years. When he had recovered from his sickness, he dedicated a votive offering at Delphi — the second of his house to do so — a great silver mixing-bowl with an iron stand welded together, the latter being, above all the offerings at Delphi, a sight well worth seeing. It was the work of Glaucus of Chios, who was the first of all men to discover the art of welding iron.
